scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:client
scripts.install:services: cd api-gateway && npm install && cd ../node-service && npm install && cd ../edge-service && npm install && cd ../media-service && npm install && cd ../ai-service && npm install && cd ../queue-service && npm install
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:node" "npm run dev:edge" "npm run dev:media" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:queue" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.prisma:generate: cd node-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../edge-service && npx prisma generate && cd ../media-service && npx prisma generate
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd node-service && npx prisma migrate dev && cd ../edge-service && npx prisma migrate dev && cd ../media-service && npx prisma migrate dev
